subject.title: fix(agent-core): bound harness exec stdout/stderr at 16 MiB

question: Should `NodeExecutionEnv.exec` truncate captured stdout and stderr at 16 MiB per stream by default, with `maxOutputBytes` as the opt-up path for large-output callers?
rationale: The patch fixes a real availability risk, but it changes the public `@openclaw/agent-core` shell execution return contract for existing consumers that intentionally capture more than 16 MiB.

options.title: Accept bounded capture as the new contract
options.body: Land the PR with the 16 MiB per-stream default and treat `maxOutputBytes` as the supported opt-up for callers that intentionally need larger captured output.

options.title: Require large-output compatibility proof
options.body: Ask for a focused note or test proving existing harness consumers can raise `maxOutputBytes` before accepting the default cap.

options.title: Preserve full capture by default
options.body: Pause this PR and redesign around an opt-in cap if maintainers consider unbounded full capture part of the current harness contract.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded capture as the new contract
recommendation.body: Land the PR with the 16 MiB per-stream default and treat `maxOutputBytes` as the supported opt-up for callers that intentionally need larger captured output.
